positions.name: DecisionAndItsRecord
positions.frame: How does the summary record of the database decision relate to the decision, its stated justification, and its timeline as originally announced?
positions.why: The three original statements (adoption, performance justification, timeline) and the later bulleted summary all describe the same Zypherion decision, but the directional reads diverge in ways worth holding together rather than apart: conviction marks src-1, src-3, and src-4 as performed 'decision' acts while src-2 sits as a supporting 'claim'; affect and register shift from activated-positive/technical in the live justification (src-2) to calm-positive/matter-of-fact in the summary (src-4); power shifts from legitimate/rational-persuasion/pressure in the originals to a flatter informational stance in the record. The tension is real and unresolved: the summary (footed to Xena ExpertGH, not Quinton, and flagged by pass-2 as unreferenced commentary) restates as settled record exactly what the originals performed as live, authority-ranked decision-making — the set holds both the performing and the recording without collapsing one into the other.
